**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mr Raikes](../persons.html#1223),
I am very sorry to have been so long answering your note. I have been from home, and have come back into a great confusion, and much that is trying.[^2] I believe I can quite manage without a chapter of yours this time, so I hope you will not hurry yourself to let me have one before the 18th of October.

In much haste and confusion,

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: Probably as a result of the move from Otterbourn House to Elderfield.
